title: Natural native open tensor comparisons on cochain complexes
statement: For a native open tensor datum s, termwise restriction commutes naturally with the left-first total tensor of any two unbounded native cochain complexes. The total tensor of termwise extension by zero of a U-complex with a Z-complex is naturally isomorphic to termwise extension by zero of the total tensor of the U-complex with the restriction of the Z-complex. These statements concern the actual cochain functors, before localization.

          (upperStar k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ≅

          ((upperStar k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
            Functor.uncurry.obj (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l U))
      (_g : ((extensionByZero k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).prod (𝟭 _) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l Z) ≅
        (𝟭 _).prod ((upperStar k₀ l j).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)) ⋙
          Functor.uncurry.obj (nativeTensorTotal k₀ l U) ⋙
